title: Accounts Assistant
description:
**Position Scope**

The Accounts Assistant is responsible for supporting day-to-day accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring timely processing of financial transactions. The role focuses on managing Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable activities, invoice processing, vendor and customer reconciliations, and maintaining accounting records using Tally and ERP systems.

**Purpose**

To ensure efficient and accurate execution of accounting activities, support financial operations, maintain proper documentation, and facilitate timely payments, collections, and reconciliations in accordance with company policies and procedures.

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B.Com) or Master's Degree in Commerce (M.Com).

**Experience Requirements**

* 2–5 years of proven experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Hands-on working experience in Tally and ERP software is mandatory.
* Experience in Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable activities.
* Experience in invoice processing, vendor payments, customer collections, and account reconciliation.
* Experience in a manufacturing industry is preferred.
* Knowledge of GST, TDS, and basic statutory compliance requirements.

**Competency Requirements**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial procedures.
* Proficiency in Tally and ERP accounting software.
* Good working knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes.
* Knowledge of GST, TDS, and bank reconciliation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS Office applications.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Commitment to values and culture.

**Responsibilities**

* Handle day-to-day accounting transactions and maintain accurate financial records.
* Process and verify purchase invoices, vendor bills, and other supporting documents in Tally and ERP systems.
* Manage Accounts Payable activities, including vendor invoice processing, payment preparation, and outstanding payment follow-ups.
* Manage Accounts Receivable activities, including customer invoicing, payment tracking, and collection follow-ups.
* Maintain and update vendor and customer accounts and ledgers.
* Perform bank reconciliation, vendor reconciliation, and customer account reconciliation.
* Ensure timely recording of purchase, sales, payment, receipt, and expense entries.
* Assist in GST and TDS-related documentation and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal departments regarding invoices, payments, and account-related queries.
* Monitor outstanding payables and receivables and follow up for timely closure.
* Assist in monthly closing activities and preparation of financial reports.
* Ensure proper filing, documentation, and maintenance of financial records.
* Support internal and external audits by providing the required accounting documents and information.
* Ensure compliance with company accounting procedures, policies, and financial controls.
* Demonstrate and promote values, culture, and ethical business practices in all work-related activities.

**Key Result Areas (KRA)**

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries in Tally and ERP systems.
* Timely processing and verification of vendor invoices and Accounts Payable activities.
* Effective management of Accounts Receivable, including customer invoicing and collection follow-ups.
* Timely completion of bank, vendor, and customer account reconciliations.
* Accuracy and completeness of financial records and supporting documentation.
* Timely completion of GST and TDS-related documentation and compliance support.
* Effective monitoring and follow-up of outstanding payables and receivables.
* Timely submission of accounting reports and completion of monthly closing activities.
* Adherence to company accounting procedures, financial controls, and compliance requirements.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Area Sales Manager – Private Bottled LPG Gas**

**Roles & Responsibilities**

An Area Sales Manager (ASM) in a private LPG bottled gas company is responsible for developing sales, managing distributors, expanding the customer base, achieving sales targets, and ensuring smooth cylinder distribution across the assigned territory.

**1. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve monthly and annual LPG cylinder sales targets.
* Develop new markets and expand the company's geographical presence.
* Increase sales of domestic and commercial LPG cylinders.
* Identify new business opportunities in residential, commercial and industrial segments.
* Develop institutional customers such as hotels, restaurants, hospitals and factories.

**2. Distributor & Dealer Management**

* Appoint new LPG distributors and dealers.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing distributors.
* Monitor distributor-wise sales performance.
* Ensure adequate cylinder stock availability at distributor points.
* Resolve distributor complaints and operational issues.
* Conduct regular distributor visits and performance reviews.

**3. Market Development & Competition**

* Conduct market surveys and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor pricing, schemes and market activities.
* Identify untapped markets and potential customers.
* Implement local marketing and promotional activities.
* Improve market share and brand visibility.

**4. Team Management**

* Manage and guide Area Sales Officers and Sales Executives.
* Set individual sales targets and monitor performance.
* Conduct regular sales review meetings.
* Train the sales team on products, customer acquisition and sales techniques.
* Ensure productivity and accountability of the sales team.

**5. Revenue & Collection Management**

* Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
* Monitor distributor credit limits and overdue accounts.
* Control bad debts and credit exposure.
* Prepare sales forecasts and revenue reports.
* Ensure profitability and achievement of business targets.

**6. Operations & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Coordinate with plant and logistics teams for cylinder dispatches.
* Monitor cylinder availability and delivery schedules.
* Ensure timely replenishment of distributor stocks.
* Monitor cylinder movement, returns and reconciliation.
* Coordinate resolution of supply-related issues.

**7. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable LPG safety regulations and company policies.
* Promote safe cylinder storage, handling and transportation.
* Ensure distributors and delivery personnel follow prescribed safety procedures.
* Report accidents, leakages and safety incidents immediately.
* Coordinate safety training and inspections.

title: Procurement Executive
description:
**Job Description – Procurement Executive**

**About Kabadiwalla Connect**

Kabadiwalla Connect is an award-winning company that provides smart waste collection and processing solutions for cities in the developing world. Through pioneering business processes and ICT-based technology, Kabadiwalla Connect integrates the informal recycling ecosystem into the reverse-logistics supply chain, helping brands and waste management companies recover post-consumer waste efficiently, cost-effectively and inclusively.

With recognition from MIT, The Ellen MacArthur Foundation, The World Bank, The World Economic Forum, Dubai Expo 2020 and the Launch Circular Innovation Ecosystem, our work strongly aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals by diverting waste from landfills and improving livelihood opportunities in the informal sector.

**Role Overview**

Kabadiwalla Connect is looking to hire a **Procurement Executive** responsible for developing and expanding the organisation's procurement network across the informal recycling ecosystem and industrial sector.

The role will focus on identifying potential suppliers, building relationships, converting them into active procurement partners and ensuring a consistent supply of recyclable materials at competitive prices and required quality standards.

The candidate will work closely with waste pickers, scrap shops, aggregators, informal material recovery facilities (MRFs), industries, commercial establishments, recyclers and other material suppliers. The role requires extensive field engagement, supplier acquisition, business development, price negotiation and end-to-end procurement coordination.

The candidate will be expected to take ownership of supplier onboarding and conversion, develop new procurement channels, maintain strong supplier relationships and achieve material procurement targets in terms of quantity, quality, pricing and consistency.

**Key Responsibilities1. Supplier Identification & Business Development**

* Identify and map potential suppliers of recyclable materials across the informal sector and industrial ecosystem.
* Conduct regular field visits to scrap shops, waste pickers, aggregators, informal MRFs, industries, factories, commercial establishments and other material-generating locations.
* Identify potential suppliers based on material availability, quality, quantity, pricing and supply consistency.
* Approach and engage new suppliers to introduce KC's procurement model and establish business relationships.
* Convert prospective suppliers into active procurement partners and develop a consistent supplier network.
* Explore new geographies, industrial clusters and material procurement opportunities to expand KC's sourcing network.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with suppliers to ensure recurring material supply.

**2. Procurement & Material Sourcing**

* Procure recyclable materials such as paper, plastics, metals and other identified material categories from informal-sector suppliers and industries.
* Understand material availability, generation patterns, market prices and supplier requirements.
* Ensure procurement targets are achieved in terms of material quantity, quality, pricing and timelines.
* Coordinate with suppliers to plan material collection, aggregation and delivery.
* Identify opportunities to procure materials directly from industries and bulk waste generators.
* Develop procurement channels for post-industrial and post-consumer recyclable materials.
* Ensure a consistent and reliable supply of materials to meet KC's project and business requirements.

**3. Supplier Conversion & Relationship Management**

* Regularly engage with existing and prospective suppliers to understand their business operations and procurement expectations.
* Negotiate material prices, payment terms, supply volumes and other commercial conditions.
* Explain KC's procurement processes, quality requirements, traceability systems and business arrangements to suppliers.
* Onboard suppliers by completing the required documentation and registration processes.
* Maintain regular communication and follow up with suppliers to ensure continued participation and material supply.
* Resolve supplier-related concerns, including pricing disagreements, quality issues, payment follow-ups and logistical challenges.
* Develop supplier relationships that encourage long-term engagement and repeat transactions.

**4. Material Quality, Pricing & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Assess material quality, segregation levels, contamination, moisture and other relevant specifications before procurement.
* Coordinate material sampling and quality assessments wherever required.
* Monitor market price fluctuations and benchmark procurement prices across different suppliers and locations.
* Ensure procurement is undertaken at commercially competitive rates while maintaining supplier relationships.
* Coordinate with transporters, aggregators, processing facilities and buyers to ensure timely material movement.
* Monitor material quantities, weighment, dispatch, receipt and delivery confirmations.
* Identify and address discrepancies in material quality, quantity, pricing and delivery.
* Work closely with the operations team to ensure that procured materials meet buyer and project specifications.

**5. Procurement Data, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated database of existing and prospective suppliers, including their locations, contact details, material categories and procurement potential.
* Maintain supplier onboarding records, procurement registers, price trackers and transaction documentation.
* Track supplier-wise procurement volumes, purchase prices, material quality and supply frequency.
* Monitor conversion of prospective suppliers into active suppliers and track repeat procurement.
* Prepare regular reports on procurement performance, supplier acquisition, material availability and market developments.
* Maintain purchase records, weighment slips, invoices, bills and other supporting documents.
* Provide regular updates to the management team on procurement performance, challenges and new business opportunities.

**6. Coordination with Internal Teams**

* Coordinate with project, operations, finance and sales teams to align procurement activities with organisational requirements.
* Work with the operations team to plan collection, transportation, aggregation and material handling.
* Coordinate with the finance team on supplier payments, purchase documentation and transaction reconciliation.
* Work with the sales and project teams to understand buyer requirements and ensure procurement aligns with material demand.
* Provide field-level feedback on supplier behaviour, market pricing, material availability and operational challenges.
* Support the development and implementation of procurement strategies across KC's projects.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 1–3 years of experience in procurement, purchase, sales, business development, supply chain, field operations or a related role.
* Experience in the waste management, recycling, scrap trading, plastics, paper or circular economy sectors is preferred.
* Experience in supplier acquisition, business conversion, field sales or vendor development will be an advantage.
* Ability to identify, approach and convert new suppliers into active business partners.
* Comfortable conducting extensive field visits and engaging with informal-sector stakeholders, including waste pickers, scrap dealers and aggregators.
* Ability to engage with industrial establishments, factories and commercial organisations to develop procurement partnerships.
* Good negotiation, relationship management and business development skills.
* Understanding of recyclable materials, material quality, market pricing and procurement processes is preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to converse effectively in Tamil and English.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage field activities, and achieve procurement targets.
* Strong follow-up skills and ability to work within deadlines.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other standard office tools.
* Ability to maintain accurate procurement records and prepare reports.

**Job Type**

Full-time

**Salary**

₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability for the role

Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Lead Message Experience Analyst serves as a subject-matter expert for highly complex and high-impact customer-facing billing statements and communications across Residential and Small to Medium Business experiences. The role leads solution design, requirements, risk assessment, validation, issue resolution, and control improvements; influences cross-functional decisions; and provides functional leadership to ensure accurate, timely, compliant, scalable, and reliable billing communications. As a lead professional, this role operates with a high degree of independence in a complex, high-volume environment and exercises judgment in matters of significance. The role provides subject-matter expertise, leads and improvement initiatives, and identifies opportunities to strengthen controls, improve automation, reduce risks, and enhance the message experience.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and validation of highly complex or high-impact billing statement content, customer communications, and related configurations.
* Provide subject-matter expertise on customer scenarios, system logic, platform capabilities, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and implementation impacts.
* Translate ambiguous or strategic business, legal, regulatory, and customer needs into scalable requirements, business rules, solution options, and execution plans.

* Lead resolution of critical defects, customer-impacting issues, recurring exceptions, and data-quality concerns; verify corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify significant risks and control gaps, recommend mitigation, and strengthen quality, compliance, data-integrity, and operational-control practices.
* Guide reporting and analysis on statement quality, defects, operational performance, implementation results, risk indicators, and emerging issues.
* Recommend solutions and influence decisions based on customer impact, business value, regulatory considerations, system dependencies, timing, and data.
* Coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives across business, technology, development, legal, compliance, operations, and vendor partners.
* Establish reusable standards, documentation, processes, and best practices that improve consistency, scalability, and execution quality.

* Experience leading requirements, solution design, business rules, process flows, validation strategies, release readiness, and operational documentation for significant initiatives.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, proofreading, and attention-to-detail skills with a record of resolving systemic issues and recommending scalable solutions.

* Ability to evaluate customer, business, financial, regulatory, operational, and technical impacts and influence decisions across functions.

title: Operation Executive - E-commerce & Order Fulfilment
description:
About BackdropSource

BackdropSource is a global e-commerce business serving customers across international markets. We focus on delivering quality products and seamless customer experiences through efficient operations, strong coordination, and technology-driven processes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Executive to support our post-sales operational workflow. Once the Sales Team confirms a sale, you will handle the day-to-day execution: checking order details, verifying invoices, coordinating shipping, following up with vendors, and tracking each order through to delivery. You will work closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics, and Customer Support, and report to the Operations Lead.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Order processing**

* Review confirmed orders for product specifications, quantities, pricing, customer requirements and delivery commitments.
* Check that all required information and documents are available before processing begins.
* Update order status at each stage and flag any delays or missing information to the Operations Lead.

**2. Invoice verification**

* Check customer invoices and purchase invoices against confirmed sales orders, quotations, purchase orders and agreed pricing.
* Verify product descriptions, quantities, taxes, shipping charges, discounts and payment terms.
* Raise discrepancies with Sales and Finance, and escalate unresolved ones to the Operations Lead.
* Keep accurate records of verified and approved invoices. Final approvals stay with the Operations Lead and Finance.

**3. Shipping & logistics coordination**

* Coordinate with couriers, freight forwarders and logistics vendors to book and dispatch shipments.
* Verify delivery addresses, shipping methods, freight costs and estimated delivery timelines.
* Prepare shipping documents and share tracking details with Sales and Customer Support.
* Follow up on delayed, lost, damaged or returned shipments until they are resolved.

**4. Vendor and supplier follow-up**

* Follow up with suppliers and manufacturers on product availability, production timelines and dispatch schedules.
* Report vendor delays, quality issues or pricing mismatches to the Operations Lead.

**5. Cross-team coordination**

* Act as the day-to-day contact for order-related queries from Sales, Finance, Warehouse and Customer Support.
* Pass order requirements and deadlines clearly between teams.

**6. Order tracking and delivery**

* Monitor orders from confirmation through dispatch to final delivery, and flag at-risk deliveries early.
* Keep clear records for completed, delayed, cancelled and returned orders.

**7. Reporting (MIS)**

* Maintain order trackers and prepare daily and weekly reports on pending orders, delayed shipments, invoice discrepancies and open issues.
* Follow the team’s SOPs and suggest improvements where you see repeated problems.

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy and turnaround time of invoice verification
* Order processing turnaround time
* On-time shipment and delivery percentage
* Number of order, invoice and documentation errors
* Timely, accurate status updates and reports
* Adherence to SOPs

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in operations, order management, logistics or e-commerce operations.
* Basic understanding of invoicing, billing checks and shipping documentation.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple orders at once.
* Clear written and spoken English, and good follow-up discipline.
* A proactive attitude and a strong sense of ownership.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with international e-commerce orders or cross-border shipping.
* Familiarity with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms.
* Experience handling international invoices and working with freight or courier vendors.
* Comfort using automation and AI tools to speed up routine work.

title: Retail Counter Sales Executive
description:
Role Overview

The **Retail Counter Sales Executive** serves as the primary face of the store, directly engaging with walk-in customers, contractors, and clients. This role combines consultative selling, product demonstrations, point-of-sale (POS) billing, and stock coordination to deliver a smooth customer experience and drive daily store revenue.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Customer Assistance & Sales**

* Greet walk-in customers, understand their specific material/product requirements, and recommend suitable options.
* Explain product features, grades, brand differences, warranties, and practical usage clearly.
* Cross-sell and up-sell complementary materials, tools, and accessories to increase average ticket value.
* Maintain professional coordination with regular clients, technicians, and contractors visiting the counter.

**2. Billing & Counter Operations**

* Generate accurate estimates, delivery challans, and GST tax invoices using the store billing system / POS software.
* Handle customer payment collections across cash, UPI, card, and credit ledger entries.
* Reconcile daily counter cash, UPI collections, and credit slips at the end of each shift before handover.

**3. Stock & Display Management**

* Ensure display shelves, sample boards, and counter areas are organized, clean, and properly priced.
* Monitor fast-moving counter stock and alert the procurement team before items run out.
* Coordinate with the warehouse/stock boy for retrieving bulk materials against customer bills.
* Assist in receiving incoming shipments, verifying physical item counts against delivery challans, and shelving.

**4. Customer Follow-up & Support**

* Follow up on customer quotes, pending orders, and scheduled deliveries via phone or WhatsApp.
* Address basic customer queries, replacement requests, or material return procedures as per store policy.
* Maintain records of out-of-stock inquiries to help the store track unmet demand.

Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:** Higher Secondary (12th Pass) or Bachelor’s degree in any stream.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in retail counter sales, wholesale counter billing, or front-desk customer service (hardware, paints, building materials, electronics, or general retail preferred).
* **Software Knowledge:** Basic computer literacy; familiarity with POS software, or Excel for billing and lookups.
* **Communication:** Clear local language fluency (Tamil/English/Hindi depending on regional walk-ins); polite, patient, and persuasive demeanor.
* **Core Competencies:** Basic mental math for quick discounting and measurements, punctuality, product recall, and conflict resolution.

Typical Working Conditions

* Retail shop floor environment with continuous customer interaction.
* Standard retail shift timings, including weekend coverage.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Associate
description:

This role is responsible for driving revenue through membership enrolments and subscriptions within the designated territory, while upholding the highest standards of service excellence, professionalism and operational efficiency.

**Location:** Luxury Hotels across Metros and Mini Metros

* Membership enrolments and membership revenue

* Membership attrition percentage

* Maintain a thorough understanding of programme performance and business objectives.

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Hospitality, Hotel Management, Aviation, Travel Management or a related discipline.

title: Area Sales Manager - Industrial Adhesives & Tapes
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

The Sales Manager is responsible for driving profitable growth within an assigned territory by acquiring new customers, expanding wallet share with existing accounts, and delivering value through application-based solutions. The role requires strong customer engagement, solution-selling, and disciplined execution to meet sales, margin, and collection targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Growth**

* Achieve monthly/quarterly/annual revenue and product mix targets.
* Drive new business development (NBD) through prospecting, lead conversion, and pipeline management.
* Execute account plans and opportunity strategies in alignment with OP (Operating Plan) and OLCG goals.

**Customer Engagement & Solution Selling**

* Conduct regular customer visits, technical demos, trials, and joint application development.
* Identify customer needs and recommend adhesives/tapes solutions that improve process efficiency.
* Coordinate with technical service/application engineers to ensure successful trials and adoption.

**Territory & Funnel Management**

* Manage territory coverage, call cycles, and visit frequency to maximize reach and productivity.
* Maintain a healthy opportunity funnel with accurate stage definitions, value, and probability.
* Use the designated CRM for lead tracking, meeting notes, action plans, and forecasting.

**Commercial Excellence**

* Prepare and negotiate proposals within pricing and discount guardrails.
* Ensure on-time invoicing, collections, and DSO adherence; resolve billing and payment issues proactively.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer risks; update counter-strategy plans.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with marketing for Ad Merch programs, campaigns, and promotion-led demand generation.
* Collaborate with supply chain for stock allocations, backorder mitigation, and aged inventory liquidation.
* Align with finance on credit limits, CIR impacts, and budget adherence.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Adhere to company policies on ethics, safety, EHS, trade compliance, and documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of trials, approvals, contracts, and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or Business (Mechanical/Chemical/Production preferred) or equivalent experience.
* 3–7 years of field sales experience in industrial/B2B (adhesives, tapes, industrial consumables, or related).
* Proven track record in solution selling, negotiation, and closing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with OEMs, converters, fabricators, and key accounts in automotive, electronics, packaging, construction, or general manufacturing.
* Hands-on exposure to process lines (e.g., lamination, assembly, gasketing, bonding); understanding of substrates and surface prep.
* Proficiency with CRM (e.g., Salesforce), Excel, and data-driven forecasting.

**Core Competencies**

* **Product & Application Knowledge** – Understand bonding mechanisms, test methods, and ROI/TCO.
* **Consultative Selling** – Diagnose problems and build value-led proposals; handle objections.
* **Territory Discipline** – Plan visits, optimize routes, and maintain call cadence.
* **Negotiation & Margin Protection** – Balance price, value, and terms within guardrails.
* **Data Literacy** – Use CRM and reports for pipeline, forecast accuracy, and performance tracking.
* **Resilience & Ownership** – Target orientation, self-motivation, and bias for action.
* **Collaboration** – Work seamlessly with technical, marketing, supply chain and finance.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue vs OP; OLCG contribution.
* NBD wins: number/value; conversion cycle time.
Funnel health: coverage (* 3×), stage progression, forecast accuracy.
* DSO, collection efficiency, and overdue reduction.
* Ad Merch program effectiveness (leads, trials, conversions).
* Customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction
* Visit productivity: calls/week, qualified meetings, trial-to-adoption rate.

**Travel & Work Conditions**

* Field-intensive role; ~50–70% travel within territory.
* Customer site work may require PPE and adherence to plant safety norms.
* Early starts or late visits as per customer production schedules.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will be responsible for driving sales and business development activities in the assigned region. The role entails developing regional business, managing key accounts, and achieving sales and collection targets through direct customer engagement, project pursuit, and channel development. The incumbent will also play a key role in implementing the company’s business strategy and ensuring market growth.

**1. Sales Planning & Business Development**

* Execute the regional sales and business development plan in alignment with national targets and objectives.
* Identify and develop business opportunities across infrastructure, industrial, institutional, commercial, and residential segments.
* Generate and manage project pipelines, ensuring timely follow-ups and order conversions.
* Develop business through Consultants, PMCs, Contractors, Developers, Ready-mix concrete producers, and government departments.

**2. Key Account & Channel Management**

* Build and nurture strong relationships with key developers/ clients, consultants, and ready-mix concrete producers in the assigned territory.
* Ensure product specifications and vendor registrations with major clients and govt. departments.
* Initiate admixture trials and product sampling/ mock-ups with key clients and coordinate with the technical service team to execute the same.
* Manage and expand distribution networks, ensure channel partner performance and alignment with company policies.
* Support and coordinate with applicators and channel partners for project execution.
* Achieve sales and collection targets as per approved budgets.

**3. Market Intelligence & Customer Support**

* Track competition activities to identify emerging trends and new business opportunities.
* Ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints in coordination with the technical and QA teams.
* Provide feedback on product performance, pricing, and customer requirements to the National Manager.
* Ensure product demonstrations, site trials, and technical presentations for key customers.

**4. Sales Process, Reporting & Collections**

* Sales Targets: Plan and execute monthly and quarterly sales activities to achieve assigned sales and product mix targets.
* Maintain and update CRM records — leads, opportunities, quotations, and order closures.
* Credit Control - Monitor outstanding payments, follow up for collections, and maintain DSO within target limits.
* Prepare and submit periodic MIS reports on sales, forecasts, and customer activity.

**5. Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Technical Services, SCM, and Accounts teams for order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate with the Technical teams for product establishment, trials, approvals and specification initiatives.
* Support marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and promotional events within the assigned region.

**6. Compliance & Ethical Conduct**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, pricing structures, and credit guidelines.
* Maintain ethical conduct, transparency, and integrity in all business dealings.
* Follow EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) standards during site visits and field operations.

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Diploma / B.Tech in Civil or Chemical Engineering (preferred) or B.Sc. (Physics / Chemistry / Maths).
* MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience:**

* 4-7 years of experience in Project Sales / Business Development in Construction Chemicals, Concrete Admixtures, or related Building Materials industry.
* Proven experience in dealing with consultants, PMCs, contractors, applicators, and government/institutional clients.

**Nature of Experience:**

* Should have worked in project-based sales and technical sales roles.
* Experience in both direct and channel-based business preferred.
* Capable of managing regional business independently and achieving defined KPIs.

**Specific Skills / Personal Attributes:**

* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated, result-oriented, and capable of handling multiple priorities.
* Good analytical and interpersonal abilities.
* Customer-centric approach with strong follow-up and execution discipline.
* Proficiency in CRM, MS Office, and report preparation.

provides a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth, learning, and recognition. With over 300 high-energy professionals, we encourage knowledge sharing, innovation, and collaboration across functions.

**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. description:
**Job Summary:**

We are excited to announce the job opening for the role of Business analyst in Emerson. In this role, we expect the candidate to serve as the key liaison between business stakeholders, Project Managers, Enterprise IT teams, and development resources for the implementation and enhancement of the Integrated Project Management System (iPMS) using Oracle Primavera Unifier and P6. This role is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, analyzing business processes, translating functional needs into technical solutions, and ensuring successful delivery of system capabilities that support the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The Business Analyst drives project execution by coordinating with cross-functional teams, monitoring progress, tracking deliverables, and providing regular status reporting to ensure timely completion of project modules and business objectives.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Partner with Project Managers, Enterprise IT teams, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
* Conduct workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and process reviews to understand current and future business needs.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs for Oracle Primavera Unifier.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across the Quote-to-Cash process, including Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Order Management, and Documentation teams.
* Act as the primary liaison between business users and developers, ensuring clear communication of requirements and solution expectations.
* Support solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and user acceptance activities.
* Drive development teams toward timely completion of project modules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Track project progress, manage action items, identify risks and dependencies, and escalate issues when required.
* Monitor implementation schedules and provide regular status reports, dashboards, and project updates to leadership and stakeholders.
* Support integration requirements involving enterprise applications, reporting platforms, and workflow systems.
* Validate delivered solutions against business requirements and coordinate defect resolution with IT and development teams.
* Develop process documentation, business procedures, training materials, and user guides.
* Facilitate user training, system adoption, and change management activities.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement within project management and operational workflows.
* Support governance, reporting, and data quality initiatives within the iPMS ecosystem.

**Who You Are:**

* You are responsible for bridging the gap between IT and the business using data analytics to assess processes, determine requirements and deliver data driven recommendations and reports to executives and stakeholders. Facilitate meetings to engage with Business leaders and users to understand how the changes in process / products / services / software and hardware can improve efficiency and add value. You should articulate the ideas and balance them against technological feasibility, finance and functional requirements.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Engineering Degree in any discipline
* 8+ years’ experience in Project / Product Management or as a Business Analyst
* Experience with SQL, Power Bi, Tableau
* Experience in any ERP Software (Preferably Oracle & SAP).
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Certification in PGP/PGDM in Data Analytics/Business Analytics/Data Science and Engineering/AI/ML is an added advantage.
* Knowledge in Agile / Scrum, Critical Thinking Skills or Techniques.
* Certification in SAFe POPM, Human Centric Design preferred.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Primavera P6 and Primavera Unifier
* Exposure to Process Industry
* Good knowledge in Power Platforms, Azure DevOps.
* Good Knowledge in MS Office

**Our Culture & Commitment to You**

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave

MRL REAL ESTATEJOB DESCRIPTION – REAL ESTATE ACCOUNTS & OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE

**Department:** Accounts, Administration & Project Operations  
**Job Location:** MRL Building, Sriperumbudur  
**Position:** Permanent, Full-Time  
**Qualification:** B.Com  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years (Freshers with good skills can apply)  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday  
**Salary:** ₹20,000–₹40,000 per month  
**Performance Incentive:** ₹10,000–₹20,000 per month  
**Additional Benefits:** Travel Allowance and Food Allowance  
**Probation Period:** 6 Months

1. JOB PURPOSE

MRL Real Estate is looking for a responsible, proactive and multi-skilled candidate to manage the company's accounting, administrative, customer coordination and real estate project operations.

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, handling customer enquiries and booking documentation, monitoring project accounts, coordinating site visits and tracking the progress of ongoing real estate projects.

The selected candidate should be willing to handle both office-based and field-based responsibilities.

2. KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

**A. Accounts & Finance Management**

* Maintain daily accounting entries using Zoho Books and Tally.
* Maintain daily cash book, bank book and expense registers.
* Record customer advances, plot booking amounts and sale collections.
* Maintain plot-wise payment and outstanding balance statements.
* Record vendor payments, contractor bills and development expenses.
* Prepare payment vouchers, receipts, invoices and supporting documents.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliation.
* Track project-wise income, expenses and profitability.
* Prepare monthly accounts statements and MIS reports for management.
* Coordinate with the company's auditor and CA for accounting records and supporting documents.

**B. Real Estate Sales & Customer Handling**

* Handle incoming customer enquiries through phone, WhatsApp and other channels.
* Explain basic project details, plot availability, pricing and payment terms to prospective customers.
* Maintain customer databases and enquiry follow-up records.
* Coordinate plot bookings, advance payments and customer documentation.
* Maintain customer-wise booking forms, receipts and payment schedules.
* Follow up with customers for pending payments and registration schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales team for customer visits and property inspections.
* Maintain records of customer feedback, complaints and requirements.
* Provide customers with regular updates regarding their bookings and project progress.

**C. Site Visit & Project Coordination**

* Visit MRL Real Estate project sites as required.
* Coordinate with site supervisors, contractors, engineers and vendors.
* Monitor ongoing development activities such as road work, compound walls, drainage, electricity and other infrastructure.
* Collect daily or weekly site progress updates.
* Take site photographs and videos and maintain project progress records.
* Track project-wise development expenses and contractor payments.
* Verify contractor bills against work progress and supporting approvals before forwarding them for payment.
* Maintain project-wise development schedules and pending work lists.
* Report delays, additional expenses and site-related issues to management.
* Coordinate with the sales team to ensure plots are ready for customer visits.

**D. Project Accounts & Documentation**

* Maintain separate accounts for each real estate project.
* Maintain project-wise land purchase, approval, development and marketing expenses.
* Track plot inventory – available, booked, sold and on-hold plots.
* Maintain plot-wise sales value, customer advances and balance collections.
* Prepare project-wise revenue and expenditure statements.
* Maintain records of land documents, approval documents, customer agreements and registration details.
* Maintain digital and physical files for every project.
* Prepare monthly project performance reports for directors.

**E. Office Administration**

* Maintain office records, files and documentation.
* Coordinate office purchases, maintenance and general expenses.
* Maintain staff attendance and basic administrative records.
* Coordinate with banks, vendors, consultants and government offices when required.
* Handle general office correspondence, emails and communication.
* Ensure all financial and project-related documents are properly organised.

3. SOFTWARE & TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

The candidate should have or be willing to develop knowledge in:

* Zoho Books – Accounting and financial entries.
* Tally – Accounting and bookkeeping.
* MS Excel – Financial statements, payment trackers and MIS reports.
* Google Sheets – Project and customer tracking.
* MS Word – Documentation and reporting.
* WhatsApp Business – Customer communication and follow-ups.
* Basic knowledge of real estate transactions, plot bookings and property registration.

4. DAILY WORKING SYSTEM

The candidate is expected to follow a structured daily reporting system.

ActivityExpected outputDaily accountingUpdated cash and bank entriesCustomer handlingEnquiry and follow-up registerBooking managementUpdated plot booking recordsCollection trackingCustomer-wise outstanding reportSite coordinationSite visit and progress updatesProject accountsProject-wise expense trackingAdministrationUpdated office recordsManagement reportingDaily work summary5. MONTHLY REPORTS TO BE SUBMITTED

The candidate must prepare the following reports for management:

* Monthly sales and booking report.
* Project-wise customer collection report.
* Pending payment and outstanding report.
* Project-wise income and expenditure statement.
* Monthly cash flow statement.
* Vendor and contractor payment report.
* Plot inventory and availability statement.
* Site development progress report.
* Customer enquiry and conversion report.
* Monthly administrative expense report.

6. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

* B.Com graduate.
* 0–2 years of experience; freshers can apply.
* Basic accounting knowledge is essential.
* Knowledge of Zoho Books and Tally is preferred.
* Good Excel and computer skills.
* Good communication and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to coordinate with site staff, customers and vendors.
* Willingness to travel to project sites.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence are mandatory.
* Must be organised, honest, responsible and willing to learn.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks independently.

7. PERFORMANCE EVALUATION

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and timely updating of accounts.
* Proper maintenance of project-wise accounts.
* Customer response and follow-up quality.
* Accuracy of booking and collection records.

title: Archt I-Solutions Archt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

**Type of Work:** Highly technical, hands-on, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on supporting senior architects on massive enterprise deals, managing smaller transactional deals independently, and building technical designs centered around enterprise networking, 5G, and Unified Communications.

**Expected Volumes:** High volume of tactical execution. You will manage multiple solution designs, design network and telecom hardware/software, build Bill of Materials (BOMs), draw network topologies, and assist in drafting technical responses for RFPs/RFIs concurrently.

**Risk & Criticality:** You are the hands-on technical validator for the team. While your architectural designs on large deals are overseen and approved by senior architects or your Manager, your ability to rapidly and flawlessly execute solution designs directly impacts deal momentum. Design failures or inaccurate BOMs can stall the sales cycle and impact margins.

### **What we’re looking for...**

* **Technical Sales Support:** Partner with Solution Architects and Account Executives to provide tactical support on large deals. This includes generating accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs), creating detailed network topology diagrams, and drafting technical RFP/RFI responses.
* **Mid-Market Solution Design:** Take full ownership of solution architecture and technical pre-sales for smaller, lower-complexity transactional deals (e.g., standard branch office networking or basic UCaaS deployments), applying best practices learned from the team.
* **Cross-Functional Technical Handoff:** Package successful solution designs,, and technical documentation to ensure a clean, seamless handoff to the internal Implementation teams once a deal is closed.
* **Basic Tool Automation:** Identify opportunities to use basic scripts (e.g., Python, REST APIs) to speed up repetitive lab setups or configuration tasks.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.

* **2 to 4 years** of hands-on technical experience in networking, network engineering, tech support, or a junior pre-sales/systems engineering role.
* **Hands-on Networking Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and LAN/WAN architectures (equivalent to a CCNA level of knowledge).
* Deep understanding on software-defined networking (SDN) or SD-WAN, 5G, RAN and UCC concepts
* Thorough knowledge of cloud computing principles (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how traditional networks connect to cloud environments.
* Entry-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA, Cisco DevNet Associate, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or CompTIA Network+/Security+

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Hands-on in software-defined networking (SDN) or SD-WAN, 5G, RAN and UCC services.
* **Hands-on Automation Skills:** Practical experience writing scripts to automate technical tasks. Familiarity with Python, Ansible, JSON/XML, REST APIs, and using tools like Postman
* Understanding, integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) including prompt engineering and tool/function calling.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Import Customer Support Executive
description:
**Company Profile**

Morulaa Healthtech is a fast-growing technology company building AI-driven regulatory and compliance solutions, helping over 500+ global medical device and IVD manufacturers navigate complex regulatory pathways into India, the EU, the USA, and ASEAN markets. Our platforms and expert services help organizations automate document-heavy workflows and streamline market entry into high-growth regions.

**Why This Role Exists**

As Morulaa expands its client base of international medical device and IVD manufacturers exporting into India, seamless operational and client support becomes critical. We are seeking an energetic, detail-oriented Import Customer Support Executive (1-2 years experience) to bridge client communication, regulatory tracking, and supply chain/import clearance workflows.

In this role, you will act as a primary communication link between our global clients, internal regulatory consultants, and logistics/customs stakeholders. You will manage customer queries, track import registration milestones, assist with import documentation verification, and ensure an effortless client onboarding and post-approval support experience.

**What You’ll Do**

**Client Communication & Account Support:**

* Act as the direct customer-facing point of contact for international medical device importers and manufacturers, handling daily inquiries via email and phone calls with exceptional clarity and professionalism.
* Proactively provide regular status updates to clients regarding their Indian CDSCO import registration applications, shipment documentation, and query resolutions.

**Import Documentation & Regulatory Support:**

* Coordinate with clients to gather, verify, and track key import documentation, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Free Sale Certificates (FSC), and ISO 13485 certificates.
* Assist the regulatory team in verifying CDSCO Form MD-14/MD-15 import license application packages to ensure alignment with shipment documentation.

**Logistics & Customs Coordination:**

* Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners to track imported medical device/IVD consignments arriving at Indian ports.
* Assist in resolving operational delays, bill of entry queries, or import hold-ups by retrieving required technical/regulatory support documents swiftly.

**Process Management & Issue Resolution:**

* Log, track, and resolve client support tickets and operational escalations within defined response windows.
* Maintain precise, up-to-date digital client records, interaction logs, and document repositories across internal CRM and electronic document systems.

**What You Bring**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Strong English-medium academic background with impeccable oral and written business communication skills.

**Experience:**

1-2 years of experience in Customer Support, Client Operations, Import/Export Coordination, or Account Management (experience in Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, or Medical Devices is a strong plus).

**Communication & Interpersonal Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with an articulate, polite, and persuasive phone/email manner.
* Ability to communicate complex process steps clearly to international clients across different time zones.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong active listening, customer empathy, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Exceptional time management, multi-tasking skills, and meticulous attention to detail under tight deadlines.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Basic understanding of Indian CDSCO import procedures, Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017, or custom clearance processes.
* Prior experience interacting with overseas clients (US, EU, APAC regions).
* Familiarity with logistics terms (Incoterms, Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, HS Codes).

description:

Krish Musicals is a leading distributor and retailer of musical instruments, pro audio equipment, and sound solutions. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality gear and exceptional service to musicians, institutions, and audio professionals. We are seeking an experienced and meticulous **Accounts Executive** to oversee our daily financial accounting, reconciliation processes, and management reporting.

**Role Overview**

As an Accounts Executive, you will manage our day-to-day financial accounting and record-keeping operations. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate cash and bank records, performing detailed reconciliations, ensuring inventory and ledger accuracy in Tally, and generating regular Management Information System (MIS) reports to support business decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Core Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Maintain and manage day-to-day accounting transactions, including cashbook, bank transactions, and ledger entries in **Tally**.
* Maintain accurate records of Petty Cash, daily cash receipts, and store/field disbursements.
* Process accounts payable (vendor invoices) and accounts receivable (customer payments, institutional billing, and outstanding recoveries).
* Ensure proper filing, indexing, and documentation of all tax invoices, vouchers, and financial records.

**Reconciliation & Compliance**

* Perform regular **Bank Reconciliations** (BRS) and resolve any discrepancies promptly.
* Conduct periodic **Ledger Reconciliations** for suppliers, institutional buyers, and retail accounts.
* Assist in physical stock audit reconciliations against inventory records recorded in Tally.
* Coordinate with internal/external auditors during financial reviews and audits.

**MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly **MIS Reports** (Sales vs. Collections, Cash Flow Statements, Expenses Analysis, and Outstanding Ageing Reports) for management review.
* Analyze financial data to highlight cost-saving opportunities and operational cash flow trends.
* Assist management with budget tracking, cash flow forecasting, and month-end/year-end closing procedures.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting field.
* **Experience:** **3 to 5 years** of hands-on experience in core accounting (retail, trading, or distribution industry experience is a plus).
* **Technical Skills:**
* Advanced proficiency in **Tally Prime / Tally ERP 9**.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Sumifs) and MS Office.
* In-depth understanding of double-entry accounting principles, cashbook management, and BRS.
* **Competencies:**
* High accuracy, attention to detail, and analytical capability.
* Strong integrity, organizational skills, and ability to meet reporting deadlines.
* Clear communication skills in English and Tamil.

* Competitive salary aligned with industry standards and experience.
* Stable, structured work environment within a growing retail and distribution business.
* Employee discounts on musical instruments and accessories.

This is a builder role, focused on creating and strengthening distributor networks, expanding pharmacy and general trade (GT) channels, increasing retail penetration, developing field sales teams, and driving sustainable secondary sales growth.

The ideal candidate should have strong Tamil Nadu market knowledge and hands-on experience in distributor management, pharmacy/GT channels, retail expansion, secondary sales, and field team leadership.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

**Type of Work:** Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.

**Expected Volumes:** Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.

**Risk & Criticality:** You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.

### **What we’re looking for...**

* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive Deal Sponsorship:** Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization:** Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* **Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM:** Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* **Deal & Technical Escalation:** Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural & Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) *prior* to contract signature.
* **Strategic Product Advocacy:** Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* **AI/Automation Acumen:** Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* **Comprehensive Core Networking:** Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* **Advanced Wireless & 5G:** Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* **Voice/UC Expertise:** Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* **Cloud Computing Expertise:** Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:
Key responsibilities

**Daily accounting**

* Record sales, purchase, receipt, payment and journal entries in Tally Prime / ERP.
* Reconcile daily showroom cash, card, UPI and finance-scheme collections against sales bills.
* Prepare and verify bank deposits; complete bank reconciliation weekly.
* Maintain petty cash and expense vouchers with supporting bills.

**Payables and receivables**

* Verify purchase invoices against GRNs and purchase orders before booking.
* Track and process payments to brands, distributors and service vendors on due dates.

* Calculate and deduct TDS; support quarterly TDS return filing.
* Generate e-invoices and e-way bills where required.
* Maintain records for statutory and internal audits and respond to auditor queries.

**Reporting and stock**

* Prepare monthly branch-wise sales, margin and expense reports for management.
* Support month-end closing, provisions and ledger scrutiny.
* Assist in periodic stock audits and reconcile book stock with physical stock.

Target

Weekly, zero unexplained items

GST data ready for filing

By the 8th of each month

Vendor payments on due date

100%

* MS Excel: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables and basic formulas for reconciliations and reports.
* Familiarity with bank portals, GST portal and TRACES.

* High accuracy and attention to detail with numbers and documents.
* Honest, organised and able to meet monthly deadlines.

To identify new business opportunities, develop customer relationships, generate enquiries, and drive sales growth for Jigs, Fixtures, Assembly Fixtures, Checking Fixtures, Automation Solutions, and related precision engineering products.

* Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, and regular follow-ups to understand project requirements.
* Coordinate with customers to obtain RFQs, drawings, technical specifications, and project details. **Enquiry Handling & Quotation**
* Review customer enquiries, drawings, BOQs, and technical requirements in coordination with the engineering team.
* Coordinate with design, manufacturing, and costing teams to prepare competitive quotations.
* Submit quotations, follow up on commercial negotiations, and convert enquiries into confirmed purchase orders. **Technical & Engineering Coordination**
* Understand customer requirements related to welding fixtures, assembly fixtures, checking gauges, machining fixtures, inspection fixtures, and automation projects.
* Coordinate with design and engineering teams to ensure technical feasibility and alignment with customer specifications.
* Support technical presentations, design reviews, and customer approval processes. **Sales & Revenue Growth**
* Achieve assigned sales targets, order booking targets, and revenue objectives.
* Develop new accounts and increase business opportunities with existing customers.
* Monitor the sales pipeline, enquiry conversion ratio, order status, and customer payment commitments. **Project & Order Follow-up**
* Coordinate with internal teams to monitor project progress, manufacturing schedules, trials, and delivery commitments.
* Communicate project status, delivery timelines, and technical updates to customers.
* Support customer acceptance, installation, commissioning, and after-sales requirements, wherever applicable. **Market Research & Competitor Analysis**
* Analyse market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities, and pricing strategies.
* Identify emerging opportunities in fixture manufacturing, precision machining, and industrial automation.
* Recommend new products, services, and market expansion strategies. **Documentation & Reporting**
* Maintain customer databases, enquiry registers, quotation records, sales forecasts, and order tracking reports.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly business development reports.
* Maintain records of customer visits, follow-up actions, RFQs, purchase orders, and sales performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Mechatronics, or Business Administration.
* Experience in business development, technical sales, or marketing in Jigs & Fixtures, Tooling, Precision Machining, or Industrial Automation.
* Good understanding of engineering drawings, manufacturing processes, fixture concepts, and technical specifications.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to identify new customers, generate enquiries, and convert opportunities into orders.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, email communication, and CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Willingness to travel for customer visits and business development activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new customers acquired.
* Number of enquiries and RFQs generated.
* Quotation submission and follow-up performance.
* Order booking and sales revenue achieved.
* Enquiry-to-order conversion ratio.
* Growth in existing customer business.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat business.
* Collection follow-up and achievement of assigned business targets.

**Reporting To:** Business Development Head / Sales Head / Management

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

title: Assistant Manager- Outside Sales
description:
**Overview**

**IMI plc**

  

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world — creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control,

and Transport.

  

We employ approximately 10,000 people in over 50 countries around the world, find out more about lMl plc here

  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Responsible for managing the assigned territory for India Aftermarket Controls business in full alignment with IMI CCI policies.
* Maintain strong customer relationships with all plants in the designated area.
* Conduct regular plant visits to support outage planning, improve plant performance, reduce downtime, and promote IMI CCI aftermarket solutions.
* Build and maintain long‑term relationships with plant owners/operators to secure ongoing business and future sales references.
* Plan and manage sales activities by ensuring accurate, up‑to‑date information in the CRM (SFDC).
* Stay informed about global and local market trends, upcoming projects, and relevant industry events within the assigned territory.

  

**Sales**

* Maintain and regularly update all commercial activities in the IMI CCI CRM as per management requirements.
* Stay informed on customer tender portals/sources and record them in CRM.
* Coordinate with inside sales to obtain and submit budgetary proposals for customer outages.
* Receive RFQs, translate/clarify, and forward them to inside sales promptly.
* Review proposals from inside sales and submit them to customers quickly, preferably in person.
* Actively follow up on submitted proposals.
* Forward customer purchase orders to inside sales immediately and assist with translations/clarifications.
* Support communication between inside sales/project management and customers to avoid shipment or payment issues.
* Assist finance with overdue cash collection when required.
* Promote IMI and IMI CCI Aftermarket functions during customer interactions.
* Attend IMI CCI meetings/conferences and contribute to overall business profitability.
* Collaborate with IMI CCI sales teams (Marketing, Nuclear, Upgrades, Follow-On) in IMI’s best interest.
* Work with Application Engineering and Technical Services to ensure optimal customer support.

  

**Plant Visits**

* Plan and conduct plant visits ahead of outages to promote IMI CCI aftermarket products and solutions and record all visits in the CRM.
* During visits, perform walk‑downs to inspect installed valves/controllers, take inspection notes, and update them in the CRM.
* Check warehouse inventories during plant visits and inform customers of replenishment needs.
* Carry appropriate and approved PPE to customer sites to safely perform inspections and inventory checks.

  

**Outage Management**

* Maintain and update planned outages at plants/units in the IMI CCI CRM tool.
* Being aware of the sources for information on plant outages and staying updated on this information, as well as reflecting it in the IMI CCI CRM tool.

  

**Forecasting**

  

* Keep the IMI CRM continuously updated with opportunities, outages, sales visits, OVC data, and other required inputs to ensure accurate forecasting.
* Prepare 5‑year sales forecasts for all active plants in the assigned territory within the CRM.
* Provide ongoing forecasts as required by management through the CRM and supply short‑term outage, OVC, and opportunity forecasts in other formats when requested.

  

**Desired skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/chemical/Instrumentation Engineering with 6-10 years in handling technical sales experience, preferably control valves, actuators, pumps, compressors, or other mechanically related equipment, preferably control valves or other mechanically related equipment.
* General working knowledge of Power Plants, Fertiliser, Oil & Gas production / processing facilities is preferable.
* Good understanding of commercial terms used in industry and knowledge of Sales Process including tender/enquiry process.
* Excellent time management and interpersonal skills essential.
* Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written required, in English & local language if any.

* Demonstrated ability to understand and leverage Artificial Intelligence, applying AI-driven strategies and tools to modernize legacy systems and enhance data migration efforts.
